Hi Olivia / Devon —

Thanks again for the time today — really helpful to walk through Helix's priorities. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can lock a 30-minute demo that answers the decision criteria you outlined.

Recap (from our discovery)
- Primary goal: reduce model inference latency for anonymized queries across multi-tenant workloads (P95 target ~120ms).
- Compliance: need audit logs and encryption-in-transit + at-rest; likely SOC 2 evidence required.
- Cost sensitivity: plan to evaluate cost-per-1M-tokens and tradeoffs with quantized variants.
- Stakeholders: Data Platform (Olivia), Security (Devon), and one ML infra owner.

Suggested 30-min demo focus
- 20 min: product walkthrough (runtime, batching, routing policies)
- 5 min: security/compliance highlights (audit logs, KMS integration)
- 5 min: next steps & success criteria alignment

Proposed time options (PT) — please pick one or suggest alternatives:
1) Wed May 20 — 9:30–10:00 AM PT
2) Wed May 20 — 2:00–2:30 PM PT
3) Thu May 21 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT

Ask: if you can confirm which two stakeholders will attend (security + ML infra preferred), and whether you want an extended security deep-dive afterwards (we can add 30 min with our security lead).

I've attached the Helix requirements summary you shared during the call for quick reference.

Attachments: Helix-Requirements.pdf (summary)

Thanks — I’ll hold the above windows temporarily until EOD PT.

—Priyom
